## Projects

- [Curio](https://curio-sity.vercel.app/): Article aggregator that ranks 60+ RSS sources by how people actually read them. Source scoring blends bookmark and read rates into feed ranking; parallel ingestion with per-source timeouts; scheduled, timezone-aware email digests with HMAC-signed unsubscribe links. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Resend, Tailwind.
- [Nivora](https://nivora-seven.vercel.app): Autonomous AI agent for civic grievance redressal. Classifies complaints, routes them to the right department with an SLA, and autonomously escalates with a re-drafted complaint when deadlines are breached. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Tailwind.
- [FolderMage](https://folder-organizer-frontend-k7r8.vercel.app/): Desktop file organizer (in active development) with deep directory scanning, SHA-256 duplicate detection, and an undoable history system. Stack: Fastify, Drizzle, Redis, Next.js, Electron, Docker, PM2.
- [AskAI](https://askai-nu.vercel.app/): Turns meeting recordings and documents into real-time summaries and action items. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, PostgreSQL.
- [PharmaGuard](https://photonx-rift-2026.vercel.app/): Pharmacogenomic risk prediction — scores drug safety from patient genetic data (VCF) against CPIC guidelines with AI-generated clinical explanations. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind.
